module.name: Product visibility rules
module.description: Limits which products an administrator role sees by the products’ catalogue prices, and lets a sales channel’s products follow a configurable rule. Switching it on applies at once: a role that handles quote requests and is not mapped sees no products until it is mapped. Switching it off lifts every product restriction: every restricted role sees all products while it is off. The configuration is kept.
settingLabels.product_visibility_rules.m: On: mapped roles see their category; unmapped quote handlers see none until mapped. Off: every restriction is lifted.
